618-1916-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

719-5413-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5413-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-2921-4186-6689-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

480-4247-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.

When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.

3605-3967-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Fiend enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

11-2928-3617-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2928-3617-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Walk.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Walk spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Walk spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Walk and returning the original Time Walk to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Walk from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

1183-4306-4853.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least two.
1183-4306-4853.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {2}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4306-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it.
When Thermopod dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
628-5231-6972.notes: If Thermopod starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

407-5200-6474.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

Activate Qala by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Qala triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

3967-6872--5.description:

When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

5541-6848-6849.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to proliferate or a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite after an opponent gains control of it.
5541-6848-6849.description:
Donate control of Bloodcrazed Hoplite to an opponent.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite either by proliferating or by any other method.
Bloodcrazed Hoplite triggers, targeting any creature controlled by you or another opponent.
When the opponent commits that crime, Patrolling Peacemaker triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Bloodcrazed Hoplite.
Repeat from step 3.

301-1099-5508.description:
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {1}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.

1308-3875-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1308-3875-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner each trigger twice.
Resolve both Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

643-2921-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-2921-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
